name: tests-half-github-mcp-server-named-http-route-profiles
instr:
github-mcp-server cannot expose multiple named MCP route profiles from one HTTP server. Add profiles with canonical external endpoints and fixed policy. Preserve the selected profile's identity through routing, policy enforcement, authentication, discovery, server cards, and representation.

Treat equivalent path spellings as one canonical identity. Report ambiguous profile names, reserved discovery collisions, and incompatible endpoint overlaps as `ProfileError`. A conflict must leave no route reachable, including routes from earlier valid declarations. Give every profile the complete MCP route family. Route, header, or query selections may only narrow fixed read-only, insiders, and toolset policy. `middleware.WithRequestConfig` must apply this narrowing itself: when the request context already holds toolsets (the profile's fixed policy), it narrows the toolsets header (`headers.MCPToolsetsHeader`) selection to those toolsets instead of replacing them. Prevent aliases, wildcard requests, and concurrent profiles from leaking identity. Each profile card must advertise its reachable MCP endpoint. Preserve negotiation, method, conditional-request, and cache behavior, including trusted request-derived origins. The routing package exposes `Profiles` on `ProfileSet`, `RouteMatcher`, `Match` on `RouteMatcher`, and `NewRouteMatcher`; the servercard package exposes `NewHandler`.

For legal nesting, select the longest matching endpoint and preserve the unmatched relative path. Toolset
